messages:
ravi: quick report — mobile SDK observed duplicate token refreshes when app backgrounded and network flaps (~200ms).
tess: which okhttp + retrofit?
ravi: okhttp 4.11.0, retrofit 2.9.0, Pixel 6 emulator (api 34).
mike: is refresh triggered inside an interceptor sync or suspend?
ravi: suspend call inside interceptor using coroutine adapter. we tried a synchronized flag but multiple calls still start.
tess: sounds like new RealCall objects on retry so per-call lock fails. use a process-wide inflight map keyed by user id.
mike: also run refresh on Dispatchers.IO so you don't tie up OkHttp dispatcher threads.
ci-bot: reproduced in CI: auth/refresh-duplicate-emu-3123 failing.
ravi: implementing inflight Deferred map + dedicated scope, adding emulator test toggling network. will PR.
tess: include emulator repro command and okhttp version in PR.
mike: add unit test with flaky socket factory to assert single refresh.
ci-bot: linked logs: https://ci.internal/issue/3123
